exposure: Gestational hypertension vs. Pre-eclampsia vs. Eclampsia vs. Chronic Hypertension
cohort: 205 antenatal women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy at gestation ≥28 weeks in a rural tertiary center of Northern India over one year (January-December 2018)
finding: Hypertensive disorder of pregnancy was associated with adverse perinatal outcome, especially in women with severe disease (Eclampsia and Pre-eclampsia).
birth_weight: Lower in eclampsia and pre-eclampsia groups
